Database URL (defaults to local SQLite) DATABASE_URL: str = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL", "sqlite:///./bugbounty.db") # Path to initial dataset DATA_FILE: str = os.getenv("DATA_FILE", "data/programs.json") # Enable/disable live API fetching (future extension) USE_LIVE_APIS: bool = os.getenv("USE_LIVE_APIS", "false").lower() == "true" # Logging level LOG_LEVEL: str = os.getenv("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO") settings = Settings() ``` ### `database.py` ```python from sqlalchemy import create_engine from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker, declarative_base from config import settings # SQLite doesn't support concurrent writes well; use check_same_thread=False engine = create_engine(settings.DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}) SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine) Base = declarative_base() def get_db(): """Dependency that yields a DB session and ensures cleanup.""" db = SessionLocal() try: yield db finally: db.close() ``` ### `models.py` ```python from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, JSON from pydantic import BaseModel, Field from typing import List, Optional from database import Base # SQLAlchemy Model class BugBountyProgram(Base): __tablename__ = "programs" id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True) name = Column(String, index=True, nullable=False) platform = Column(String, nullable=False) # e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Independent url = Column(String, nullable=False) bounty_min = Column(Float, default=0.0) bounty_max = Column(Float, default=0.0) vuln_types = Column(JSON, default=[]) # e.g., ["XSS", "SQLi", "IDOR"] reputation_score = Column(Float, default=0.0) # 0-10 scale ease_of_participation = Column(String, default="medium") # low/medium/high last_updated = Column(String, nullable=True) # Pydantic Schemas for API validation class ProgramBase(BaseModel): name: str platform: str url: str bounty_min: float = 0.0 bounty_max: float = 0.0 vuln_types: List[str] = [] reputation_score: float = 0.0 ease_of_participation: str = "medium" last_updated: Optional[str] = None class ProgramCreate(ProgramBase): pass class ProgramResponse(ProgramBase): id: int class Config: from_attributes = True class SearchFilter(BaseModel): """User-defined selection criteria""" min_bounty: Optional[float] = None max_bounty: Optional[float] = None vuln_types: Optional[List[str]] = None min_reputation: Optional[float] = None ease: Optional[str] = None platform: Optional[str] = None limit: int = Field(default=50, ge=1, le=200) ``` ### `crud.py` ```python from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from models import BugBountyProgram, SearchFilter from core.filters import apply_filters def get_programs(db: Session, filters: SearchFilter): """ Fetch programs from DB and apply selection criteria. Filtering is delegated to core/filters.py for testability. """ query = db.query(BugBountyProgram) query = apply_filters(query, filters) return query.limit(filters.limit).all() def insert_program(db: Session, program_data: dict): """Insert a single program into the database.""" db_program = BugBountyProgram(**program_data) db.add(db_program) db.commit() db.refresh(db_program) return db_program ``` ### `core/filters.py` ```python from sqlalchemy import and_ from models import BugBountyProgram, SearchFilter def apply_filters(query, filters: SearchFilter): """ Apply selection criteria to SQLAlchemy query. Criteria: bounty range, vuln types, reputation, ease, platform. """ conditions = [] if filters.min_bounty is not None: conditions.append(BugBountyProgram.bounty_max >= filters.min_bounty) if filters.max_bounty is not None: conditions.append(BugBountyProgram.bounty_min <= filters.max_bounty) if filters.min_reputation is not None: conditions.append(BugBountyProgram.reputation_score >= filters.min_reputation) if filters.ease: conditions.append(BugBountyProgram.ease_of_participation == filters.ease.lower()) if filters.platform: conditions.append(BugBountyProgram.platform.ilike(f"%{filters.platform}%")) if filters.vuln_types: # JSON contains any of the requested vulnerability types for vtype in filters.vuln_types: conditions.append(BugBountyProgram.vuln_types.contains([vtype])) if conditions: query = query.filter(and_(*conditions)) # Default sorting: highest max bounty, then reputation query = query.order_by(BugBountyProgram.bounty_max.desc(), BugBountyProgram.reputation_score.desc()) return query ``` ### `core/ingestion.py` ```python import json import requests from pathlib import Path from config import settings def load_local_data(filepath: str = None) -> list[dict]: """Load initial dataset from JSON file.""" path = Path(filepath or settings.DATA_FILE) if not path.exists(): return [] with open(path, "r") as f: return json.load(f) def fetch_hackerone_public_programs() -> list[dict]: """ Placeholder for HackerOne public directory API. Note: H1 doesn't offer a fully open API for bounty ranges. This function demonstrates where API integration would live. """ # Example: requests.get("https://hackerone.com/directory/programs", ...) # Parse & normalize to match BugBountyProgram schema return [] def normalize_program(raw: dict) -> dict: """Ensure incoming data matches DB schema expectations.""" return { "name": raw.get("name", "Unknown"), "platform": raw.get("platform", "Independent"), "url": raw.get("url", "#"), "bounty_min": float(raw.get("bounty_min", 0)), "bounty_max": float(raw.get("bounty_max", 0)), "vuln_types": raw.get("vuln_types", []), "reputation_score": float(raw.get("reputation_score", 0)), "ease_of_participation": raw.get("ease_of_participation", "medium").lower(), "last_updated": raw.get("last_updated") } ``` ### `scripts/seed_db.py` ```python import sys sys.path.append("..") from database import SessionLocal, engine, Base from crud import insert_program from core.ingestion import load_local_data, normalize_program Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine) def seed(): db = SessionLocal() try: programs = load_local_data() for p in programs: insert_program(db, normalize_program(p)) print(f"✅ Seeded {len(programs)} programs.") finally: db.close() if __name__ == "__main__": seed() ``` ### `api/routes.py` ```python from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from database import get_db from models import SearchFilter, ProgramResponse from crud import get_programs router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1", tags=["programs"]) @router.post("/search", response_model=list[ProgramResponse]) def search_programs(filters: SearchFilter, db: Session = Depends(get_db)): """ Search bug bounty programs using selection criteria. Returns filtered, sorted results. """ try: results = get_programs(db, filters) return results except Exception as e: raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e)) @router.get("/health") def health_check(): return {"status": "ok", "message": "Bug Bounty Finder API is running."} ``` ### `main.py` ```python from fastapi import FastAPI from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from fastapi.responses import FileResponse from api.routes import router from database import Base, engine import os # Create tables on startup Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine) app = FastAPI( title="Bug Bounty Finder", description="Search & filter bug bounty programs by compensation, vuln type, reputation, and ease.", version="1.0.0" ) app.include_router(router) # Serve static frontend STATIC_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "static") app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory=STATIC_DIR), name="static") @app.get("/") def serve_frontend(): return FileResponse(os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, "index.html")) ``` ### `data/programs.json` (Sample Seed Data) ```json [ { "name": "Acme Corp", "platform": "HackerOne", "url": "https://hackerone.com/acme", "bounty_min": 100, "bounty_max": 5000, "vuln_types": ["XSS", "IDOR", "CSRF"], "reputation_score": 8.5, "ease_of_participation": "high", "last_updated": "2024-05-10" }, { "name": "SecureBank", "platform": "Bugcrowd", "url": "https://bugcrowd.com/securebank", "bounty_min": 500, "bounty_max": 15000, "vuln_types": ["SQLi", "RCE", "Logic Flaw"], "reputation_score": 9.2, "ease_of_participation": "medium", "last_updated": "2024-06-01" } ] ``` ### `static/index.html` (Minimal UI) ```html Bug Bounty Finder

🔍 Bug Bounty Program Finder

``` ### `static/script.js` ```javascript document.getElementById('searchForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => { e.preventDefault(); const payload = { min_bounty: document.getElementById('min_bounty').value ? parseFloat(document.getElementById('min_bounty').value) : null, max_bounty: document.getElementById('max_bounty').value ? parseFloat(document.getElementById('max_bounty').value) : null, vuln_types: document.getElementById('vuln_types').value.split(',').map(v => v.trim()).filter(Boolean), min_reputation: document.getElementById('min_reputation').value ? parseFloat(document.getElementById('min_reputation').value) : null, ease: document.getElementById('ease').value || null, platform: document.getElementById('platform').value || null, limit: 50 }; const res = await fetch('/api/v1/search', { method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify(payload) }); const data = await res.json(); const resultsDiv = document.getElementById('results'); resultsDiv.innerHTML = data.length ? data.map(p => `

${p.name} (${p.platform})

💰 $${p.bounty_min} - $${p.bounty_max} | ⭐ ${p.reputation_score}/10 | 🛠 ${p.ease_of_participation}

🔓 ${p.vuln_types.join(', ')}

View Program
`).join('') : '

No programs match your criteria.

'; }); ``` ### `static/style.css` ```css body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 900px; margin: 2rem auto; padding: 0 1rem; } form { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; } input, select, button { padding: 0.5rem; font-size: 1rem; } button { background: #2563eb; color: white; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .card { border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; border-radius: 8px; } .card a { color: #2563eb; text-decoration: none; } ``` ### `tests/test_filters.py` ```python import pytest from sqlalchemy import create_engine from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker from models import Base, BugBountyProgram, SearchFilter from core.filters import apply_filters @pytest.fixture def db_session(): engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:") Base.metadata.create_all(engine) Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine) session = Session() session.add_all([ BugBountyProgram(name="A", platform="H1", url="http://a", bounty_min=100, bounty_max=1000, vuln_types=["XSS"], reputation_score=7, ease_of_participation="high"), BugBountyProgram(name="B", platform="BC", url="http://b", bounty_min=500, bounty_max=5000, vuln_types=["SQLi"], reputation_score=9, ease_of_participation="medium") ]) session.commit() yield session session.close() def test_filter_by_min_bounty(db_session): q = db_session.query(BugBountyProgram) filtered = apply_filters(q, SearchFilter(min_bounty=400)) assert len(filtered.all()) == 1 assert filtered.all()[0].name == "B" ``` --- ## 🚀 How to Run ```bash # 1. Install dependencies pip install -r requirements.txt # 2. Seed the database python scripts/seed_db.py # 3. Start the server uvicorn main:app --reload # 4. Open http://localhost:8000 in your browser ``` --- ## 💡 Suggestions to Improve This Project 1. **Live Data Integration**: Replace/augment `programs.json` with official APIs (Bugcrowd, Intigriti, YesWeHack). HackerOne requires authentication & has rate limits. 2. **Reputation & Ease Scoring Algorithm**: Instead of manual scores, calculate them from: - Average response time - Payout ratio - Community reviews (e.g., from BugBountyForum or Twitter) 3. **Caching & Rate Limiting**: Add Redis caching for API responses & implement `slowapi` for rate limiting. 4. **User Accounts & Saved Searches**: Add JWT auth, user profiles, and email/Discord alerts for new matching programs. 5. **Export & Reporting**: CSV/JSON export, markdown report generator for researchers. 6. **Legal/ToS Compliance**: Add a `robots.txt` checker & explicit disclaimer. Scraping platforms without permission can violate ToS. 7. **CI/CD & Docker**: Add `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`, GitHub Actions for testing & auto-deployment. --- ## ❓ Follow-Up Questions (To Make This Production-Ready) 1. **Data Source Preference**: Should I integrate live APIs (Bugcrowd/Intigriti), build a respectful scraper, or keep it JSON/CSV-driven for now? 2. **Authentication**: Do you want user accounts, saved searches, or alert notifications (email/Discord/Telegram)? 3. **Deployment Target**: Local use, Docker, VPS, or serverless (Render/Fly.io/Vercel)? 4. **Advanced Filtering**: Should we add tags like `#mobile`, `#smart-contract`, `#hardware`, or filter by country/compliance (GDPR, SOC2)? 5. **UI Preference**: Keep the lightweight static UI, or upgrade to React/Vue with charts, pagination, and dark mode? 6. **Legal Scope**: Should I add a ToS compliance module that checks `robots.txt` and platform policies before fetching data? Reply with your preferences, and I’ll iteratively upgrade the codebase until it matches your exact vision.

SQLite doesn't support concurrent writes well; use check_same_thread=False engine = create_engine(settings.DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}) SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine) Base = declarative_base() def get_db(): """Dependency that yields a DB session and ensures cleanup.""" db = SessionLocal() try: yield db finally: db.close() ``` ### `models.py` ```python from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, JSON from pydantic import BaseModel, Field from typing import List, Optional from database import Base # SQLAlchemy Model class BugBountyProgram(Base): __tablename__ = "programs" id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True) name = Column(String, index=True, nullable=False) platform = Column(String, nullable=False) # e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Independent url = Column(String, nullable=False) bounty_min = Column(Float, default=0.0) bounty_max = Column(Float, default=0.0) vuln_types = Column(JSON, default=[]) # e.g., ["XSS", "SQLi", "IDOR"] reputation_score = Column(Float, default=0.0) # 0-10 scale ease_of_participation = Column(String, default="medium") # low/medium/high last_updated = Column(String, nullable=True) # Pydantic Schemas for API validation class ProgramBase(BaseModel): name: str platform: str url: str bounty_min: float = 0.0 bounty_max: float = 0.0 vuln_types: List[str] = [] reputation_score: float = 0.0 ease_of_participation: str = "medium" last_updated: Optional[str] = None class ProgramCreate(ProgramBase): pass class ProgramResponse(ProgramBase): id: int class Config: from_attributes = True class SearchFilter(BaseModel): """User-defined selection criteria""" min_bounty: Optional[float] = None max_bounty: Optional[float] = None vuln_types: Optional[List[str]] = None min_reputation: Optional[float] = None ease: Optional[str] = None platform: Optional[str] = None limit: int = Field(default=50, ge=1, le=200) ``` ### `crud.py` ```python from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from models import BugBountyProgram, SearchFilter from core.filters import apply_filters def get_programs(db: Session, filters: SearchFilter): """ Fetch programs from DB and apply selection criteria. Filtering is delegated to core/filters.py for testability. """ query = db.query(BugBountyProgram) query = apply_filters(query, filters) return query.limit(filters.limit).all() def insert_program(db: Session, program_data: dict): """Insert a single program into the database.""" db_program = BugBountyProgram(**program_data) db.add(db_program) db.commit() db.refresh(db_program) return db_program ``` ### `core/filters.py` ```python from sqlalchemy import and_ from models import BugBountyProgram, SearchFilter def apply_filters(query, filters: SearchFilter): """ Apply selection criteria to SQLAlchemy query. Criteria: bounty range, vuln types, reputation, ease, platform. """ conditions = [] if filters.min_bounty is not None: conditions.append(BugBountyProgram.bounty_max >= filters.min_bounty) if filters.max_bounty is not None: conditions.append(BugBountyProgram.bounty_min <= filters.max_bounty) if filters.min_reputation is not None: conditions.append(BugBountyProgram.reputation_score >= filters.min_reputation) if filters.ease: conditions.append(BugBountyProgram.ease_of_participation == filters.ease.lower()) if filters.platform: conditions.append(BugBountyProgram.platform.ilike(f"%{filters.platform}%")) if filters.vuln_types: # JSON contains any of the requested vulnerability types for vtype in filters.vuln_types: conditions.append(BugBountyProgram.vuln_types.contains([vtype])) if conditions: query = query.filter(and_(*conditions)) # Default sorting: highest max bounty, then reputation query = query.order_by(BugBountyProgram.bounty_max.desc(), BugBountyProgram.reputation_score.desc()) return query ``` ### `core/ingestion.py` ```python import json import requests from pathlib import Path from config import settings def load_local_data(filepath: str = None) -> list[dict]: """Load initial dataset from JSON file.""" path = Path(filepath or settings.DATA_FILE) if not path.exists(): return [] with open(path, "r") as f: return json.load(f) def fetch_hackerone_public_programs() -> list[dict]: """ Placeholder for HackerOne public directory API. """ # Example: requests.get("https://hackerone.com/directory/programs", ...) # Parse & normalize to match BugBountyProgram schema return [] def normalize_program(raw: dict) -> dict: """Ensure incoming data matches DB schema expectations.""" return { "name": raw.get("name", "Unknown"), "platform": raw.get("platform", "Independent"), "url": raw.get("url", "#"), "bounty_min": float(raw.get("bounty_min", 0)), "bounty_max": float(raw.get("bounty_max", 0)), "vuln_types": raw.get("vuln_types", []), "reputation_score": float(raw.get("reputation_score", 0)), "ease_of_participation": raw.get("ease_of_participation", "medium").lower(), "last_updated": raw.get("last_updated") } ``` ### `scripts/seed_db.py` ```python import sys sys.path.append("..") from database import SessionLocal, engine, Base from crud import insert_program from core.ingestion import load_local_data, normalize_program Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine) def seed(): db = SessionLocal() try: programs = load_local_data() for p in programs: insert_program(db, normalize_program(p)) print(f"✅ Seeded {len(programs)} programs.") finally: db.close() if __name__ == "__main__": seed() ``` ### `api/routes.py` ```python from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException from sqlalchemy.orm import Session from database import get_db from models import SearchFilter, ProgramResponse from crud import get_programs router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1", tags=["programs"]) @router.post("/search", response_model=list[ProgramResponse]) def search_programs(filters: SearchFilter, db: Session = Depends(get_db)): """ Search bug bounty programs using selection criteria. """ try: results = get_programs(db, filters) return results except Exception as e: raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e)) @router.get("/health") def health_check(): return {"status": "ok", "message": "Bug Bounty Finder API is running."} ``` ### `main.py` ```python from fastapi import FastAPI from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from fastapi.responses import FileResponse from api.routes import router from database import Base, engine import os # Create tables on startup Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine) app = FastAPI( title="Bug Bounty Finder", description="Search & filter bug bounty programs by compensation, vuln type, reputation, and ease.", version="1.0.0" ) app.include_router(router) # Serve static frontend STATIC_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "static") app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory=STATIC_DIR), name="static") @app.get("/") def serve_frontend(): return FileResponse(os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, "index.html")) ``` ### `data/programs.json` (Sample Seed Data) ```json [ { "name": "Acme Corp", "platform": "HackerOne", "url": "https://hackerone.com/acme", "bounty_min": 100, "bounty_max": 5000, "vuln_types": ["XSS", "IDOR", "CSRF"], "reputation_score": 8.5, "ease_of_participation": "high", "last_updated": "2024-05-10" }, { "name": "SecureBank", "platform": "Bugcrowd", "url": "https://bugcrowd.com/securebank", "bounty_min": 500, "bounty_max": 15000, "vuln_types": ["SQLi", "RCE", "Logic Flaw"], "reputation_score": 9.2, "ease_of_participation": "medium", "last_updated": "2024-06-01" } ] ``` ### `static/index.html` (Minimal UI) ```html Bug Bounty Finder
